annotation.authors_or_issuer: International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC)
key_provisions_or_claims: Draft GGE report's set of elements is a sufficient basis to launch negotiations on a legally binding instrument on autonomous weapons.
Preserve the LAWS characterization (para 25), prohibitions (paras 31-34), human judgement and control (para 36) and life-cycle requirements (paras 38-39).
Add prohibition on LAWS triggered by presence, proximity or contact of persons or targeting persons (para 35 bis).
Restore restriction of LAWS use to military objectives by nature.
Transmit work to the Seventh Review Conference with a mandate to negotiate a binding instrument in 2027.
annotation.summary_en: ICRC working paper to the CCW Group of Governmental Experts on LAWS (Sept 2026). It endorses the draft report's set of elements as a baseline for negotiating a binding instrument, urges preserving key provisions, and proposes additions: a ban on anti-personnel autonomous weapons and restriction to military objectives by nature.
